notes: Fixes Shared Sync emergency contacts that arrived on receiving phones as generic Emergency Contact shells. Glenn's iPhone remains the designated master for trip emergency contacts. When the same emergency-contact recordId already exists on a receiving phone, Shared Sync now replaces the receiver's generic/older shell with Glenn's complete Shared contact record regardless of receiver timestamp or legacy Private labeling. Other record types keep the existing newer-record merge rules. No source records on Glenn's phone are changed by this fix.
name: TEE v3.4.99 — Emergency Contact Sync Authority
